canonical_statement: The abstract endpoint Strichartz estimate of Keel and Tao, Theorem 1.2: an energy-bounded family U(t) with the stated L1-to-Linfinity dispersive bound has homogeneous, dual, and retarded inhomogeneous estimates for sharp sigma-admissible exponent pairs, subject to the theorem's endpoint exclusions.
domain_and_universes: A Hilbert space H, a compatible Banach interpolation pair (B0,B1), a time-indexed operator family U(t), real sigma > 0, and Lebesgue/Bochner spaces over R; exact Lean universes and measurability structures remain to be frozen.
quantifiers: all sharp sigma-admissible exponent pairs (q,r) and (q_tilde,r_tilde) allowed by Theorem 1.2
input data f in H and forcing term F in the appropriate dual mixed-norm space
hypotheses: energy estimate: U(t) is uniformly bounded H -> L2-type space
dispersive estimate: U(t) U(s)^* has L1-to-Linfinity decay bounded by |t-s|^(-sigma)
the compatibility, interpolation, admissibility, and exceptional-endpoint conditions of Keel-Tao Theorem 1.2
conclusion: Homogeneous, dual homogeneous, and retarded inhomogeneous Strichartz mixed-norm bounds with constants independent of the data.
excluded_degenerate_cases: The exceptional pair (q,r,sigma)=(2,infinity,1) and any boundary cases excluded by the source definition of sharp sigma-admissibility are not silently included. The exact endpoint convention must be transcribed and mutation-tested in the statement phase.
